newsitem.title: PANAMA: Perry cancels Panama visit due to laryngitis.
newsitem.headline: Perry cancels Panama visit due to laryngitis.

text.p: U.S. Defence Secretary William Perry has cancelled a planned brief visit to Panama on Saturday due to a bout of laryngitis, the Panamanian presidency said on Friday.
The Pentagon chief was due to have held a private meeting with Panamanian President Ernesto Perez Balladares at his private beach residence on the Pacific coast.
"Perry has laryngitis and will go directly to Argentina Sunday," presidential spokesman Luis Vazquez said.

U.S. Southern Command military spokesman William Ormsbee confirmed Perry would rest in Washington before leaving on Sunday to attend a regional security meeting with Latin American defence ministers in the Argentine ski resort of Bariloche.
